title: Add FT-001 account membership session schema baseline
verify: The accounts, farm_memberships, and local_sessions models/migration use PostgreSQL native UUID mapped as Python uuid.UUID with application UUIDv4 generation for account_id, membership_id, session_id, account references, and farm_id.

Required text/status/timestamp fields are non-null; password_hash is required while disabled_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at, and client_label preserve the exact FT-001 nullable rules; created_at/updated_at use non-null timestamptz with server now defaults where specified.

DB CHECK constraints reject invalid account_status, membership_status, role_preset, and auth_method values; the only values are Account active/disabled, Membership active/disabled, and auth_method local_password.
login_name persistence uses application strip().lower(), a DB normalized/non-empty check, and exactly one unique B-tree lookup on the stored normalized value.

FarmMembership.account_id and LocalSession.account_id use ON DELETE RESTRICT Account FKs; FarmMembership.farm_id is UUID/non-null with no FT-001 FK or farms table, leaving the final relation to full FT-002 design.
The schema has exactly the required unique membership, token_hash, LocalSession account_id, and expires_at indexes without duplicates; LocalSession has no raw session-token field.

A rollback-scoped PostgreSQL migration smoke applies the FT-001 migration through the Foundation Alembic path, inserts/reads representative rows, and proves UUID round-trip, normalization conflicts, checks, FK restrictions, and index behavior.
Migration path creates only Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession records and does not create Farm, Plant, PlantAccessGrant, Boss account-creation, bootstrap, or admin audit behavior.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.

constraints: Store only server-side token_hash for LocalSession; never persist raw session tokens.
Use PostgreSQL native uuid mapped as Python uuid.UUID through SQLAlchemy Uuid(as_uuid=True), with application uuid.uuid4 generation for FT-001 identifiers; do not use text or integer identifiers.
Use non-null unbounded text for Account.password_hash. Do not add a brittle PHC-prefix DB check or arbitrary maximum length.
Use one non-null 64-character LocalSession.token_hash column with exactly one unique lookup index; do not add a duplicate non-unique token_hash index.

Use exact FT-001 nullability and timestamptz rules; created_at/updated_at are non-null with server now defaults where specified, while disabled_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at, and client_label remain nullable.

Use string columns plus DB CHECK constraints for Account statuses active/disabled, FarmMembership statuses active/disabled, role presets boss/engineer/consultant, and the sole auth method local_password; do not use PostgreSQL native ENUM types.

Normalize login_name with strip().lower() before persistence, enforce normalized non-empty storage in PostgreSQL, and use one unique B-tree lookup on the stored value without citext or duplicate functional indexes.
Use ON DELETE RESTRICT for Account-to-membership/session FKs. Keep farm_memberships.farm_id UUID/non-null without a Farm FK; do not create a farms table or invent the deferred FT-002 migration.

Create exactly one unique farm_memberships(account_id, farm_id) lookup, one unique local_sessions.token_hash lookup, one local_sessions.account_id index, and one local_sessions.expires_at index without duplicates.
Do not create Farm, Plant, PlantAccessGrant, Boss account-creation/bootstrap, admin mutation, or AdminAuditRecord behavior in this task.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: PostgreSQL/read model owns mutable Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession state.
Authority relations never cascade delete; disable/revoke lifecycle semantics preserve referenced records.
Account/membership storage defines the required farm_id column and intentional initial FK absence; full FT-002 design owns final Farm relation and migration semantics.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check the migration uses the Foundation Data Substrate DB/session/Alembic path and creates only Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession tables/indexes.

Inspect model and migrated PostgreSQL metadata for exact table/column names, native UUID, timestamptz, nullability/defaults, status/role/auth checks, normalized login uniqueness, RESTRICT Account FKs, deferred farm_id FK absence, exact indexes, and no raw-token column.

Run rollback-scoped PostgreSQL migration/repository smoke covering UUID round-trip, representative active/disabled rows, invalid domain values, required password hash, duplicate normalized login, referenced Account delete rejection, and no farms table creation.
purpose: Create the FT-001 persistence baseline for local identity, membership, and sessions without implementing adjacent product features.
success_outcome: Later FT-001 tasks can use deterministic Account, FarmMembership, and LocalSession relational records with native UUID identity, exact nullability/checks/login uniqueness/non-cascading relations/indexes, token_hash-only storage, and an explicit deferred Farm FK handoff.
anti_goals: No FT-003 direct Account creation/bootstrap/admin/audit implementation.

stop_conditions: Migration would require destructive database operations.
Schema requires unresolved Farm/Plant/access or admin/bootstrap contract decisions.
Implementation requires creating a Farm table, selecting the deferred FT-002 migration, or enabling durable FarmMembership product creation.
Native UUID, normalized login uniqueness, exact DB checks, non-cascading FKs, or the required index set cannot be proven on PostgreSQL.
The required password_hash invariant or single unique token_hash lookup index cannot be enforced without contradicting the authoritative FT-001 storage contract.
Verification cannot prove token_hash-only session storage.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
